subject: The truth about your first 14 days with Smart Notes
preview_text: You've accomplished more than you think. Let me show you what the data reveals about your meeting habits.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago, you decided to stop missing key points in meetings. You decided to stop writing and start listening. That was the moment everything changed. But here's what you might not realize...

In 14 days, you've likely sat through hours of meetings. Without Smart Notes, you'd be staring at pages of messy scribbles right now, trying to remember who said what. But you're not. You've been quietly building a searchable archive of every decision, every action item, every brilliant idea that would have otherwise been lost. That's not just note-taking. That's building institutional memory.

Open the app. Tap the 'Insights' tab. I built it to show you exactly what you've accomplished. It tallies your total meeting time captured, keywords mentioned most often, and even spots patterns in your discussions you might have missed. It's the silent proof that you're becoming the most organized person in the room.

Tap below. Spend 60 seconds in the Insights tab. See your two-week progress quantified. It's the best kind of sunk cost—you've already done the work, now let the app show you the payoff. P.S. The users who check their insights weekly save an average of 30 extra minutes. They see the patterns others miss.
